answer: Mechanism: square-root voting weight. Each identity's vote counts as the square root of its earned stake, so every extra fake adds less force than the one before. A thousand coordinated fakes weigh about thirty-two honest voters, not a thousand; real consensus is anchored by the broad base of small weights, like pigment spread over a whole canvas instead of one heavy daub. The attacker keeps walking a wharf that narrows with every plank, marginal gains shrinking to nothing; honest agents lose nothing, their single square-root the exact floor each deserves.
